correctness.rationale: For a line normal m modulo pi and offset h, pair-endpoint Jacobian gives density G(m,h)=4p(m+acos h)p(m-acos h)/sqrt(1-h²). Two independent lines meeting at x have offset map Jacobian |sin(m-n)|; exact q_p(x)=int∫|sin(m-n)|G_m G_n. With x=re^{it}, δ=1-r², each normal density concentrates log mass 4p(t)² log(1/δ) at m=t mod pi while the transverse integral int sin(m-t)G_m dm->2p(t). Two mixed near/far angular sectors yield 2*4p(t)²*2p(t)=16p(t)^3; double-near sector bounded O(η log(1/δ)) and far/far O_eta(1), uniform in t by positive C¹ p. Crossing probability 1/3 follows from three equiprobable cyclic pairings; polar integration gives 48ε log(1/ε)∫p³ and cube-root inversion. In mixed sectors three endpoints cluster at t, the fourth has residual angle law p(s)ds; four labels are symmetric. The near-tangent normal offset has measure dz/|z| over sqrtδ<<|z|<<1, so U=2log(1/|z|)/log(1/δ) tends Uniform(0,1); normalized densities converge with all mass in these sectors, giving joint TV by Scheffe. Independently checked isotropic coefficient 16/(2pi)^3=2/pi³ and exact 1/3 crossing; numerical FFT finite checks not a substitute for limiting double-sector proof. Scope excludes zero/atomic p and outside-circle X.
